_doc: c3's own declaration of WHICH platforms the Infra pages Containers-as-Service and Containers-Node-Python list (owner request 2026-11-04). data/gen_fleet_slice.py reads it and fills the numbers from the fleet registry (cloudy-t-infra terraform.json); a platform the registry itself declares in fleet-assets.json container_platforms[] / hosting[] is listed too and wins on a clashing id. Containers are NOT listed here: they belong to the Containers page. Move an entry into the registry and delete it here to make the registry the only source.
